plan.p0: A line-span completion mechanism: preserve every 8, and recolor each 6 to 2 when it lies between the leftmost and rightmost 8 in its row or between the topmost and bottommost 8 in its column. Distinguishing assumption: any line with at least two 8s qualifies.
plan.p1: A thresholded line mechanism: perform the same horizontal/vertical span filling, but only on lines containing at least three 8s. This matches the observed rows and columns. Distinguishing assumption: exactly two endpoint markers would not be sufficient on another input.
plan.p2: A connected-stroke mechanism: recolor 6s lying in straight horizontal or vertical gaps whose 8 endpoints belong to one connected 8-stroke or component. Distinguishing assumption: isolated, disconnected 8 markers would not generate fills even when aligned.
plan.p3: A repeated-marker mechanism: treat any non-background color as a possible marker; between repeated markers on a row or column, recolor background cells to a designated fill color (2 here). Distinguishing assumption: another input with multiple foreground colors could use them all, rather than recognizing 8 specifically.
